glossary.definition: (1) "Criminal records check" has the same meaning as in section 109.572 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 5103.053 - Residential facility criminal records check.

glossary.definition: (2) "Person subject to a criminal records check" means a person who is under final consideration for appointment or employment in the residential facility;
glossary.normalized: person subject to a criminal records check
glossary.source_title: Section 5103.053 - Residential facility criminal records check.
glossary.term: Person subject to a criminal records check

glossary.definition:
(3) "Superintendent of BCII" means the superintendent of the bureau of criminal identification and investigation.
